hypothesis: The immutable final V57 audit must count terminal cohort runtime faults in health and technical coverage rather than inspecting only per-asset fault rows.
decision: Supersede the V57 final audit v1 health and coverage projection with v2. V57 remains stopped, flat, order-free, and economically unobserved; the corrected technical disposition is incomplete because one terminal runtime fault was recorded.

root_cause.defect: health_summary accepted only asset ledgers and therefore counted asset event_type=fault rows but could not see cohort event_type=runtime_fault rows.
root_cause.impact: V57 final audit v1 reported health.faults=0 and coverage.complete=true even though the selected cohort ledger terminated with runtime_fault.
root_cause.capital_impact: No order was attempted by the terminal fault or this correction. All three V57 assets ended FLAT with zero open orders and zero closed trades in the selected run.
root_cause.fix: Pass the selected cohort rows into health_summary, validate terminal fault evidence, report health.runtime, include runtime faults in health.faults, and let existing coverage projection mark faults_recorded.

supersession.changed_projection: health, coverage, and the derived learning next-evidence list

validation.red: The new regression reproduced health.faults=0 for a selected cohort ending in runtime_fault.
validation.green: Four focused runtime-fault tests and 79 audit/acceptance/continuous-improvement tests passed.
validation.malformed_evidence: Wrong status, empty exception type, and non-boolean orders_attempted now fail the audit.

confidence.basis: The defect was reproduced before the change; the corrected audit uses the same immutable ledger byte counts and hashes, exposes the exact terminal fault, and downstream tests consume the corrected total.
confidence.limitation: This establishes truthful fault reporting, not the root cause of the upstream transport timeout or strategy profitability.

falsifiers: Any recorded source hash or byte count changes.
Independent audit recomputation does not return one runtime fault and faults_recorded coverage.
The selected cohort ledger does not contain the reported terminal runtime_fault row.
Any V57 asset was non-flat, retained an order, or recorded a selected-run trade omitted here.
A downstream consumer still presents the corrected audit as fault-free or technically complete.

recommendation.1_recommendation: Use only the v2 final audit for V57 technical-health conclusions and preserve v1 as superseded evidence of the reporting defect.
recommendation.2_why_now: The stopped-run record is the baseline for successor research; a false healthy status would contaminate cutover and improvement reporting.
recommendation.3_evidence_reviewed: The full selected cohort and asset ledgers, both immutable audit versions, audit implementation, and downstream acceptance tests.
recommendation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: Terminal runtime faults were invisible to the health summary when no per-asset fault row existed.
recommendation.6_alternatives_considered: Leave v1 unchanged, patch the artifact manually, or correct and republish through the source-bound audit pipeline.
recommendation.8_expected_upside: Prevents a faulted run from appearing technically complete in audits and successor evidence.
recommendation.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Schema consumers may have assumed health contains only assets and a total; the additive runtime field and existing total semantics were regression-tested.
recommendation.10_validation_completed: TDD reproduction, strict malformed-row tests, downstream audit/acceptance/improvement suite, immutable replay, and source-hash reconciliation.
recommendation.11_validation_still_required: A future real stopped run should confirm the corrected field flows through its live checkpoint and TUI presentation.
recommendation.12_success_metrics: Every selected cohort runtime fault is counted, described, and causes faults_recorded technical coverage without altering economics.
recommendation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Revert only this additive reporting change if a valid historical runtime_fault schema is rejected; do not restore silent omission.
recommendation.14_confidence_level: High for reporting correctness; no profitability claim.
